description: OpenPanel is an open-source web and product analytics platform for tracking events, users, funnels, retention, and related analytics data. It can be used as a hosted service or self-hosted.
summary: openpanel.dev exposes a hosted REST API at `https://api.openpanel.dev` and a hosted MCP server at `https://api.openpanel.dev/mcp`, both authenticated with OpenPanel-issued client credentials; no documented GraphQL API, OpenAPI spec URL, or standalone CLI was found.
